title: Ship from DCLab Code: push a copy's branch, open a pull request with gh, see its checks (parity B6)
request: The owner's goal (2026-10-26 night: continue non-stop; then wire every R&D agent): Claude Code and Codex desktop's capabilities; parity B6.
plan: record each as the person's act
tests with a recording gh stub, a page test, a review

decisions.decision: Everything a PR needs (a remote, committed work, new commits, gh signed in, a base branch) is checked before the branch leaves the machine
decisions.why: a push publishes: a PR that then fails must not leave a branch on the remote

decisions.decision: Shipping is a person step in R&D's episodes, never their outcome
decisions.why: a merge stays a merge when it is pushed afterwards

change: server/worktree.js safe, readyToShip, push, ghReady, prBase, openPr, prStatus; routes POST worktree/push, POST/GET worktree/pr; palette items and the PR line; R&D's dclab_code set reads pushed and pr_opened as person steps.

findings.defect: a token in the remote's address reached the record, the page and the answer
findings.scenario: origin https://x-access-token:ghp_…@github.com/o/r.git, then Push: the note and the JSON held the token
findings.cause: git remote get-url returns the address as configured; errors quote it
findings.fix: credentials stripped from every address and error

findings.defect: a branch with no commits was published
findings.scenario: a copy with no change, then Push or Open a PR: an empty branch on origin
findings.fix: refused when the copy has no commits of its own

findings.defect: the PR's own push was not recorded, and happened before gh was checked
findings.scenario: gh missing or signed out: the branch was pushed, then 409, and the record said nothing
findings.cause: the route pushed first and recorded only the PR
findings.fix: gh auth status first; the push recorded

findings.scenario: a copy made from a detached HEAD sent --base HEAD; a local branch tracking another name targeted the wrong base
findings.cause: the base was the copy's starting branch name
findings.fix: refused for a detached HEAD; the base from the branch's upstream, else the repository's default

findings.defect: the person's own ssh setup was replaced
findings.scenario: core.sshCommand with a work key: the push used the default key or failed
findings.fix: the person's command kept, made non-interactive

findings.defect: push did not block like commit and merge
findings.scenario: a background job running, or Remove copy during a 120 s push
findings.cause: no job check, no busy flag
findings.fix: the job check and a pushing flag that commit, merge and remove respect

findings.defect: a startup failure counted as running forever
a control character in the title gave a 500 after the push

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every test passes, page tests included
measurements.result: all pass (units, server with a recording gh stub, Chromium page tests)

measurements.name: R&D store test
measurements.gate: shipping is a person step, never the outcome

outcome: A person pushes a session's work and opens a pull request from DCLab Code, and sees its checks, as in Claude Code and Codex; nothing is published without their click, and no credential is shown or kept.
lessons: Check everything a publish needs before the first byte leaves the machine.
risks: not live-checked against GitHub (the owner's repositories); a fake gh and a local bare remote stood in
